# Pull request

## What this changes

<!-- One paragraph. If it changes a conclusion, say which conclusion and why. -->

## Type

- [ ] **Correction** — a `FACT` was wrong, stale, or unsupported
- [ ] **Falsification** — an `ANALYSIS` is shown to fail
- [ ] **New document** — a research document or proposal
- [ ] **Editorial** — links, typos, formatting, cross-references
- [ ] **Housekeeping** — templates, licence, CI

## Claim integrity

- [ ] Every new `FACT` has a source + date, and that source is in `SOURCES.md`
- [ ] Every new `ANALYSIS` names the facts it reasons from
- [ ] Every new `PROPOSAL` says "not official" and includes at least one risk
- [ ] No sentence attributes intent to the Pi Core Team without a quotation
- [ ] No price, trading, referral, or promotional content
- [ ] `last_reviewed` and `evidence_cutoff` updated in every touched document
